CSS Gradients

linear-gradient(to right, ...)
Linear: to right
linear-gradient(to bottom, ...)
Linear: to bottom
linear-gradient(135deg, ...)
Linear: 135deg
linear-gradient multi-stop
Linear: 4 colors
linear-gradient hard stops (stripes)
Hard color stops
radial-gradient(circle, ...)
Radial: circle
radial-gradient(ellipse, ...)
Radial: ellipse
radial-gradient at position
Radial: at top left
repeating-linear-gradient
Repeating linear
repeating-radial-gradient
Repeating radial
gradient with alpha
Alpha gradient
